answer: Hardware TEE attestation curbs Sybil attacks by binding each agent key to a CPU-signed quote over an enclave hash, nonce, and unique chip ID. Nodes check quotes against a reef of vendor certificates before letting agents wander into task markets or enter the lotus of trusted peers. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of provisioning distinct attested silicon chips per identity. However, side-channel key extraction or compromised vendor root keys can still break isolation.
